THE ACADEMIC NOTEBOOK / 2026

Notes from the journey.

A growing collection of notes, derivations, explanations, and questions encountered while studying theoretical high-energy physics. This is where I work through ideas, connect mathematical structures with physical intuition, and record things worth revisiting.

These notes are a work in progress. They are intended as a personal learning resource and a way to share ideas, rather than a substitute for formal textbooks or published research.
